name: tia_import_scl_block
description: Import a complete SCL block source, given inline (scl_code) or as a server-local .scl file (file_path); the server creates the temporary .scl file. Existing same-name blocks are backed up (unless backup is false), deleted, and replaced; failed imports attempt to restore the backup. An inconsistent existing block is compiled once before the backup; if it stays inconsistent (or is know-how protected) nothing is replaced unless backup is false.

scl_code.description: Complete SCL source for exactly one FUNCTION, FUNCTION_BLOCK, ORGANIZATION_BLOCK, or DATA_BLOCK. Use this or file_path, not both.

file_path.description: Fully qualified server-local path to a .scl file with exactly one block declaration (read as UTF-8 unless it has a BOM; a file that is not valid UTF-8, such as an ANSI file, is rejected). Use this or scl_code, not both.

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

folder.description: Target block group path (optional; an existing block's group is preserved when omitted).

compile_after_import.description: Compile the target PLC after import (default true). Compilation errors are reported and do not roll back the imported block.

open_after_import.description: Open the imported block in the TIA Portal editor after import (default false).

backup.description: Export the existing same-name block as a backup before replacing it (default true). If that block is inconsistent it is compiled once first; if it stays inconsistent or is know-how protected, the import fails without replacing it. With false no backup is taken (a warning is returned) and a failed import cannot restore the previous block.
